decisions.title: Authoritative VCS and CI host
decisions.decision: No prior remote/history recoverable (see docs/evidence/c0.1/source-declaration.md). This snapshot on branch main commit 249594c is authoritative baseline. CI: GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml). Protected branch: main.

decisions.title: License, ownership, and release authority
decisions.decision: License: UNLICENSED - owner approval required (pyproject.toml:11). Owner: PT Meco Inoxprima (pyproject.toml:12). Release approver: Evan Widjaja, Operations approver: Evan Widjaja, Security approver: Evan Widjaja — must be named in ADR-C03 before CG1.

decisions.title: Supported deployments
decisions.decision: Linux/NAS Compose (compose.yaml, Dockerfile) and Windows Task Scheduler (scripts/install-windows-task.ps1) both mandatory. Narrowing either requires approved design change per ADR-C14.

decisions.title: Python versions
decisions.status: amended 2026-09-05 - support Python 3.14; venv 3.14.6; container python:3.14-slim-bookworm (digest pin pending per branch-protection note)
decisions.decision: Support Python 3.14; local venv 3.14.6; container python:3.14-slim-bookworm (Dockerfile:2, compose.yaml:6); immutable digest pin pending.

decisions.title: Runtime libraries
decisions.decision: Runtime dependencies intentionally empty (requirements.lock empty, pyproject.toml:13 dependencies=[]). No Pydantic/HTTPX added; stdlib used for config, HTTP, XML/JSON, URL. Any added dependency requires ADR-C10 review.

decisions.title: Missing publication dates
decisions.decision: missing_date_policy=exclude is production default (config/watchlist.json:8). Dry-run surfaces exclusion reason via filter_fresh (ranking.py:62). Narrow exception requires business approval.

decisions.title: Title-only dedupe window
decisions.decision: title_dedupe_days=14 (config/watchlist.json:5), url_retention_days=365 (config/watchlist.json:6). Canonical URL long-lived, title short-lived (storage.py:350 identity_keys).

decisions.title: Telegram ambiguity
decisions.decision: Never auto-resend. Mark ambiguous -> needs_attention, block later chunks, require audited resolve sent|retry with reason+operator (app.py:378, storage.py:943).

decisions.title: Zero-story policy
decisions.decision: Some source succeeded + zero eligible: outbox one coverage notice, complete completed_empty. All-sources-failed: durable same-day retry (app.py:292). 1-4 stories: deliver with warning.

decisions.title: Alert channel
decisions.decision: Use channel independent of production Telegram where feasible (ADR-C15). At minimum expose nonzero status/health (preflight.py:157 healthcheck + monitoring.md:14).

decisions.title: SQLite storage
decisions.decision: Local POSIX/NTFS only. SMB/NFS unsupported until explicit locking test passes (docs/deployment-linux-nas.md:3, storage.py:118 WAL).

decisions.title: Data retention
decisions.decision: Article identity >=365 days (url_retention), attempts >=90 days, backups 7 daily/4 weekly/12 monthly unless policy stronger.
